slides.label: What it means
slides.title: Bhagya
body: The old name for the 9th house: fortune
It holds your father, teachers and faith
Long trips and higher study live here too

slides.label: In modern life
slides.title: What it covers
cells: The professor who vouched for you
The year abroad that changed you

slides.label: How it works
slides.title: Luck has a teacher
body: The teacher (Jupiter) looks after this house
Luck comes through people who taught you
The more you listen, the luckier you get

slides.label: Sutra
slides.quote:
Luck is a teacher
you listened to

slides.label: Practical remedy
slides.title: Thank a teacher
body: Find your 9th house and what sits there
Write to one teacher this week
slides.closing: Ask about your 9th house at asksutram.com
